meta.title: About Thành Hoàng – Vietnam flight ticket agent since 2013
meta.description: Thành Hoàng Travel, an official flight ticket agent since 2013: our history, vision, mission and five core values — reliable, professional, convenient, transparent, caring.

hero.label: Thành Hoàng Travel · Since 2013
hero.title: Beside you on every journey.
hero.body: Thank you for trusting and travelling with us since 2013. In a spirit of care, good fortune and togetherness, Thành Hoàng is committed to service that is reliable, professional and wholehearted.
hero.company: Thành Hoàng Travel Trading and Development Co., Ltd.

history.label: Our history
history.quote: Every lasting journey begins with a steady first step.

milestones.title: Beginnings
milestones.body: Founded in 2013 to make booking a flight easy and transparent for Vietnamese travellers. From a small office in Ho Chi Minh City, Thành Hoàng quickly became an official agent of the country's major domestic airlines.

milestones.title: A technology breakthrough
milestones.body: Heavy investment in technology brought a smart online booking system with fares updated in real time. Market share leapt, and partnerships grew with many respected international airlines.

milestones.title: Fully digital
milestones.body: Ahead of travel 4.0, Thành Hoàng launched AGS99, a platform built for flight-ticket agents, along with visa support, hotel booking, travel insurance and 24/7 customer care.

milestones.title: Sustained momentum
milestones.body: More than a ticket seller, Thành Hoàng became a complete travel bridge connecting millions of passengers. The THcent system and agent incentives widened its network across the country.

vision.label: Vision
vision.title: Vietnam's leading flight-ticket provider.
vision.body: Thành Hoàng keeps innovating with technology to make booking fast, safe and cost-effective. We don't just sell tickets: we make the start of every trip smooth and dependable — for business, family visits or holidays alike.

mission.label: Mission
mission.title: Connecting millions of travellers with the sky.
mission.body: With airlines at home and abroad, we offer the most convenient, accurate and fitting way to book — so every customer can reach quality flights at competitive, transparent fares, with wholehearted support.

items.name: Reliability
items.body: On time, accurate, accountable.

items.name: Professionalism
items.body: Clear processes, a dedicated team.

items.name: Convenience
items.body: Book quickly, anytime, anywhere.

items.name: Transparency
items.body: Clear prices, no hidden fees.

items.name: Wholehearted support
items.body: Always beside you, ready to help.

finale.title: With gratitude, we wish you health and prosperity.
